description: Finds 4OVER4 custom print products (business cards, flyers, postcards, banners, stickers, labels, packaging and more) by words, category, budget or goal; use it when someone asks what 4OVER4 has for a print need. For a price use configure_product; for a goal with no product use recommend. All inputs are optional. Returns products with slug, name, From price, rating, 4OVER4's own photo (image_url) and page (url); use those photos, not pictures from other sites. Customer phrases: "soft touch business cards", "cheapest flyers", "signs for a real estate office".

angle.description: Industry, occasion, finish, material or shape paired with productType, e.g. wedding.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. business-cards, postcards, flyers.

maxTotal.description: Budget for the whole order in USD. An estimate that ignores volume discounts.

productType.description: Product type paired with angle, e.g. postcards.

query.description: Free words: an industry, occasion, finish, material, shape or product, e.g. "die cut stickers".

sort.description: Result order: most reviewed, lowest From price, highest rated or newest.

name: show_products

data.description: A product grid: slug, name, From price, rating, review count, product link.

link.description: The page on www.4over4.com to continue on: order, upload and checkout happen there.

summary.description: The facts of the result in plain sentences.
